source.title: queue_sweeper: reject negative closure and age limits before API access
source.body:
## Summary
On main commit `1f0ff978f4deff78c77bca96db0e3e46f32de71b`, `tools/queue_sweeper.py` accepts negative closure and age limits. I rechecked the current main source before reporting; the argument validation is still absent.

- `--max -1` uses Python negative slicing, selecting all but the last eligible PR rather than rejecting an invalid cap.
- `--min-age -1`, including `SWEEPER_MIN_AGE_DAYS=-1`, sets the cutoff in the future, making fresh unprotected PRs eligible for closure.

This is a tooling/input-safety improvement, not a compiler soundness or unauthorized-access claim. An invalid operator configuration is required.

## Offline reproduction and results
All GitHub API access was mocked; no real PR was closed, labelled or commented on, and no credential was used. Three fixture PRs were supplied:
| Case | Original exit | Original mocked closures | Fixed exit | Fixed API calls |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| --max -1, old PRs | 0 | 2 | 2 | 0 |
| --min-age -1, one-hour-old PRs | 0 | 3 | 2 | 0 |
| Negative environment age default, one-hour-old PRs | 0 | 3 | 2 | 0 |

The patch below includes a self-contained unittest file. Apply it to the pinned commit and run:
```sh
python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_queue_sweeper_limits.py -v
python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_shepherd_gate.py -v
python3 tools/check_conflict_markers.py
python3 tools/check_test_registration.py
```

The new suite fails four assertions/subtests without the validation and passes all five tests with it. The existing shepherd gate suite passes 12 tests. Python compilation, conflict-marker check and test-registration guard also passed locally. Zero max, zero age and positive limits remain supported. Full Rust/Go/compiler/corpus/differential validation was **not** run: the pinned toolchains are unavailable in this environment. No upstream CI result is claimed.

## Proposed patch
The validation runs immediately after parsing, before credential checks or API access. The following patch also registers the regression suite in CI and records contributor validation in PLAN/STATUS.
<details>
<summary>Complete applicable patch</summary>

```diff
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index ad833fe..944c487 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -30,6 +30,7 @@ jobs:
           python3 tools/check_conflict_markers.py
           python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_check_conflict_markers.py -v
           python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_shepherd_gate.py -v
+          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_queue_sweeper_limits.py -v
           python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_check_corpus_census.py -v
           python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/fuzz -p 'test_hyfuzz.py'
           python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/runner -p test_runner.py -v
diff --git a/PLAN.md b/PLAN.md
index 904e5e9..93d33bb 100644
--- a/PLAN.md
+++ b/PLAN.md
@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@
 # Hybrid Language: Development Plan

+- Contributor validation (2026-10-29): queue_sweeper now rejects negative --max/--min-age (including a negative environment default) before provider access. Five offline regression tests preserve zero and positive limits. Rust/Go/corpus/differential not run in this environment; upstream validation remains required.
+
 - Contributor amendment (2026-10-19, #656): current main already rejects direct pointer-receiver calls on map reads, call results, and literals. Apply its existing addressability rule when selecting method values and task callees too, preserving all other receiver rules. Regression suite covers the two residual defects and addressable controls (19 tests); full workspace/corpus/differential and CI verification remain delivery gates.
 - Contributor validation (2026-10-15): runner now checks linked-worktree Git metadata before setup/commands; wrong SHA and broken gitfile fail closed. Real-worktree regressions plus existing runner/SHA suites: 13 tests passed.
 ## Contributor validation — 2026-10-15
diff --git a/STATUS.md b/STATUS.md
index 284ef83..9db35fd 100644
--- a/STATUS.md
+++ b/STATUS.md
@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@
 # STATUS (for the human — 15 lines max)

+- Contributor candidate (2026-10-29): negative sweeper limits fail before API access; five mocked regressions registered in CI, upstream validation pending.
+
 - AUTOMATION (session-35): **the daily human-chore is gone** — triage-board.yml now runs `triage_bot.py approve --max 60` every 04:30 UTC after the board post (board FIRST: run 39897148251 proved the approve POSTs drain the shared per-repo GITHUB_TOKEN hour pool and RateGuard kills the scan otherwise; approve is best-effort with continue-on-error) · session-side sweep cleared 172 pending action_required runs (all 3 per-PR workflows, 0 left at 03:56Z) · `triage_bot.Gh.req` now retries rate-limit 403s with 5/20/45s backoff (GitHub secondary limits surface as 403, not 429; shepherd.py inherits via the shared Gh class) · BOT AUDIT: board #940 fresh, stale+rebase green on schedule, autoland gates proven honest (758/827/929/905 landed via session-side autoland.py per the session-34 GH006 finding — the workflow push transport remains the missing infra: bundle→branch→PR→checks→auto-merge)
 - LANDED (session-35, Pareto round 6): #1095 afe0c03 (ryder777777, package_release.sh dot-segment/dash/extra-arg rejection, bug live ×4 cases) · #1097 ff446e2 (ryder777777, install.sh HYB_VERSION path-component validation, bug live via regression suite failing on main) · #1098 37364a8 (ryder777777, check_test_registration start-dir escape; live-bug proof = direct probe: `-s ..` + package-chained root bypasses the guard exit-0 on main, fixed tree refuses; PR's own test passes pre-fix too — quoted-pattern weakness noted to the author) — each: merge gate clean, battery 1770/1770, corpus 126 tripwire-not-fired, differential FULL 40+86, CI compiler+quick green on heads (preflight reds were the shared-token 403 saturation, not code), credit comments posted

diff --git a/tools/queue_sweeper.py b/tools/queue_sweeper.py
index ebf1c8a..85fc791 100644
--- a/tools/queue_sweeper.py
+++ b/tools/queue_sweeper.py
@@ -85,6 +85,8 @@ def main():
     ap.add_argument("--max", type=int, default=200)
     ap.add_argument("--min-age", type=int, default=MIN_AGE)
     args = ap.parse_args()
+    if args.max < 0 or args.min_age < 0:
+        ap.error("--max and --min-age must be nonnegative")
     if not TOK:
         print("GITHUB_TOKEN not set"); sys.exit(1)

diff --git a/tools/test_queue_sweeper_limits.py b/tools/test_queue_sweeper_limits.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7cb1055
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/test_queue_sweeper_limits.py
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+"""Destructive queue commands must reject invalid limits before API access."""
+import contextlib
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+import importlib.util
+import io
+from pathlib import Path
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sweeper_limits',Path(__file__).with_name('queue_sweeper.py'))
+sweeper=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(sweeper)
+
+class QueueLimitTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def run_cli(self,args,default_age=5,fresh=False):
+        calls=[]
+        def api(path,method='GET',body=None):
+            calls.append((path,method,body))
+            if method=='PATCH': return 200,{}
+            if method=='POST': return 201,{}
+            if '/pulls?' in path:
+                return 200,[{'number':n,'created_at':((datetime.now(timezone.utc)-timedelta(hours=1)).isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z') if fresh else '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z'),'labels':[],
+                             'user':{'login':'fixture'},'title':'fixture'} for n in (1,2,3)]
+            return 200,{}
+        with patch.object(sweeper,'api',side_effect=api), patch.object(sweeper,'TOK','offline-fixture'), patch.object(sweeper,'MIN_AGE',default_age), patch.object(sweeper,'config_protected_numbers',return_value=set()), patch.object(sweeper.time,'sleep'), patch('sys.argv',['queue_sweeper.py',*args]),contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()),contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
+            try:
+                sweeper.main()
+                status=0
+            except SystemExit as e:
+                status=e.code
+        return status,calls
+
+    def test_negative_limits_abort_before_any_api_call(self):
+        for args in (['--max','-1'],['--max','-200'],['--min-age','-1']):
+            with self.subTest(args=args):
+                status,calls=self.run_cli(args,fresh=(args[0]=='--min-age'))
+                self.assertEqual(status,2)
+                self.assertEqual(calls,[])
+
+    def test_negative_environment_default_is_also_rejected(self):
+        status,calls=self.run_cli([],default_age=-1,fresh=True)
+        self.assertEqual(status,2)
+        self.assertEqual(calls,[])
+
+    def test_zero_max_makes_no_provider_mutations(self):
+        status,calls=self.run_cli(['--max','0'])
+        self.assertEqual(status,0)
+        self.assertFalse(any(method!='GET' for _,method,_ in calls))
+
+    def test_positive_max_limits_number_of_closures(self):
+        status,calls=self.run_cli(['--max','1'])
+        self.assertEqual(status,0)
+        self.assertEqual(sum(method=='PATCH' for _,method,_ in calls),1)
+        self.assertEqual(sum(method=='POST' for _,method,_ in calls),1)
+
+    def test_explicit_zero_age_remains_supported(self):
+        status,calls=self.run_cli(['--min-age','0','--max','1'])
+        self.assertEqual(status,0)
+        self.assertEqual(sum(method=='PATCH' for _,method,_ in calls),1)
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    unittest.main()
```
</details>

## Disclosure, scope and reward eligibility
Prepared and tested by an AI assistant for the ARGOS project, submitted with the account owner's authorization. I do not claim the owner personally ran these commands. Your BOUNTY.md explicitly welcomes AI authors and useful tooling improvements; please consider this track only if applicable.

A separate protection-config fix was discarded after finding existing PR #2233; it is not included here. Searches for negative sweeper limits did not identify a duplicate, but please flag one if missed. Related #1525, #2107 and #2218 have different triggers.

Could you confirm whether this contribution is eligible for the current reward cycle, and which payment routes are actually supported for an individual based in Uruguay? I understand selection is competitive, the published ladder is not a guaranteed fee, and payment eligibility/rail has not been confirmed. No wallet address, bank information or private credentials are included.
